cohort: The study included 130 term neonates, comprising 65 with birth asphyxia and 65 non-asphyxiated controls.
finding: Birth asphyxia was significantly correlated with elevated cord blood liver enzyme levels (ALT, AST, LDH) at birth and 24 hours, as well as higher incidence of HIE, seizures, and meconium-stained liquor.
